title: Net bits
summary: A bit-level codec for game state from untrusted peers: ranged whole numbers, reals on a grid within half a step, smallest-three rotations with a stated error bound, and record tables whose hash names the wire format.
provides: net_bits_writer_* / net_bits_reader_* / net_bits_write / net_bits_read / net_bits_reader_done: the bit stream, low bit first
net_bits_width / net_bits_write_int / net_bits_read_int: whole numbers in a range
net_bits_range_t / net_bits_range_width / net_bits_quantize / net_bits_write_ranged / net_bits_read_ranged: reals on a grid
NET_BITS_BOOL / UINT / INT / RANGED / QUAT, net_bits_layout_init, net_bits_write_record / net_bits_read_record, net_bits_hash_mix: record tables and their hash
